cohort: 729,503 singleton newborns with a California birth in 2005 through 2011 who had routine newborn metabolic screening and fetal ultrasound dating at 11-20 weeks' gestation
finding: Metabolic profile evaluated within 8 days of birth, when considered in combination with birthweight and hours of age at test, appears to be a useful measure of preterm birth and, among those born preterm, of specific week of gestation +/-2 weeks.
